SYNTHETIC SAMPLE — not art

Every image here is generated by tools/harmony_sample.mjs from the game's code-drawn Harmony busts, placed on the
contract template (docs/harmony/contract/CONTRACT.md). It exists to exercise the importer and the runtime
raster path; it is not art, not a style reference and not a delivery. The player is mirrored, so worn sides
are reversed. Looks (the files of Batches 1a and 1b): A ponytail + coat + glasses + flower + satchel;
B curly + robe (wide sleeve) + scarf + headband. Kit parts are painted in the five exact key shades only;
tests/fixtures/harmony_rich/ holds the many-valued (contract v3) variant of the same kit.
